era: 2019 ebay.com (the 2018-2020 desktop design): top row 'Hi! Sign in or register | Daily Deals | Sell | Help & Contact' with My eBay, bell and cart; multicolour logo, 'Shop by category', square search field with 'All Categories' and a blue Search button, 'Advanced'; a centred text category row; Helvetica type; list results with blue titles; item pages with a grey buy box and blue Buy It Now / Add to cart. Web Design Museum's 2019 capture (s1) and users' 2019 screenshots (s2-s7) agree.
